text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Delightful! Light! Super refreshing!! 
Thanks to the detergent Dober-senpai gave 
me, it's the absolute best mask ever, 
YES!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Really? That's great. I thought something 
mask-related would be perfect for you, El.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So... since it's something you put on your 
face, I tried to choose something 
unscented, but... does it feel alright on 
your skin?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! No problem at all, desu! It's like 
wearing nothing at all—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! Y-You can't possibly mean she's 
really not wearing anything... right?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Dober-senpai...! I-I... without my mask, I 
can't...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, calm down... It's fine, see? 
I've got it on properly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If you don't have it on, I'll secretly let 
you know... so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe. If it really comes down to 
that, I'll be counting on you, desu!"
